query: SELECT r.name as role, p.name as permission FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON ur.roleId = r.id JOIN role_permissions rp ON r.id = rp.roleId JOIN permissions p ON rp.permissionId = p.id WHERE ur.userId IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'staff') LIMIT 20;
